sidecar_call:codexGoalClear.note: Clears the Codex goal; ours is changeGoal with clear (it also pauses and resumes). Neither stage 2 nor the differential run sends it: no catalogue state runs a turn, so ours is shown by s1-sidecar.join.test.ts "AGENT-13 a Codex chat sets, reads, pauses, resumes and clears its goal".

sidecar_call:codexGoalGet.note: Reads the Codex goal; ours is getGoal. Neither stage 2 nor the differential run sends it: no catalogue state runs a turn, so ours is shown by s1-sidecar.join.test.ts "AGENT-13 a Codex chat sets, reads, pauses, resumes and clears its goal".

sidecar_call:codexGoalSet.note: Sets the Codex goal of a thread; ours is setGoal. Neither stage 2 nor the differential run sends it: no catalogue state runs a turn, so ours is shown by s1-sidecar.join.test.ts "AGENT-13 a Codex chat sets, reads, pauses, resumes and clears its goal".

sidecar_call:message.note: A streamed agent message (sidecar.js @267328). Ours sends every agent output as a sessionEvent. In the sidecar differential run of 2026-11-13 (scripts/conductor-reference/sidecar-diff) Conductor sent the turns' output as sessionEventNotification and no message notice; agent output reached the app in the same order on both.

sidecar_call:queryError.note: D031: there is no queryError; the failure arrives as an event and the live state. In the sidecar differential run of 2026-11-13 (scripts/conductor-reference/sidecar-diff), scenario cancel, Conductor sent queryError and ours ended the turn with turn_ended instead.

sidecar_call:codexMcpConsentDeliveryFail.note: Conductor's sidecar sends it when a Codex permission or MCP form could not reach the app or timed out, and the app then clears the card (main @3107933). Ours clears the same card through the chat's live state: the broker closes the interaction and the app drops a card the new live state no longer carries (session/interactions.ts, sessions.ts applyLiveState; approval-bridge.test.ts "a timed-out permission closes its card at the real broker, so the next one can open"). Neither stage 2 nor the differential run sends it: no catalogue state runs a turn, so ours is shown by those tests.

sidecar_call:sessionEventNotification.note: A stored event for the app to save; ours is sessionEvent. In the sidecar differential run of 2026-11-13 (scripts/conductor-reference/sidecar-diff) both sidecars sent each turn's events and the app acknowledged each one.

sidecar_call:deliverSessionEvent.note: The sidecar resends an event the app has not confirmed; ours is deliverEvent. Neither stage 2 nor the differential run sends it: no catalogue state runs a turn, so ours is shown by outbox/replay.test.ts and handlers.chat-18.test.ts "answers persisted true for a deliverEvent the ingest stored".

sidecar_call:sessionStatusNotification.note: D031: there is no sessionStatusNotification; live state and D008's turn_ended carry it. In the sidecar differential run of 2026-11-13 (scripts/conductor-reference/sidecar-diff) Conductor's turn ends were its idle status, ours were turn_ended.

sidecar_call:sessionStateNotification.note: The chat's live state; ours is liveState. In the sidecar differential run of 2026-11-13 (scripts/conductor-reference/sidecar-diff) both sidecars sent it through every turn scenario.

sidecar_call:fastModeUnavailableNotifica.note: Tells the app that fast mode is unavailable for the account; ours carries it in the chat's live state (fastModeAvailable), which the composer's banner reads. Neither stage 2 nor the differential run sends it: no catalogue state runs a turn, so ours is shown by claude-session.test.ts "the fast-mode refusal on stderr is reported".

sidecar_call:shellEnvCaptureNotification.note: Conductor sends it when a login-shell capture fails (cwd, kind, message), and the app shows an error toast (main @3098818). Ours is shellEnvFailed with the same fields; handlers.chat-18.test.ts "passes a failed login-shell capture to the shell environment port".

sidecar_call:exitPlanMode.note: The sidecar asks the app to approve leaving plan mode; ours sends requestInteraction with a plan_approval. In the sidecar differential run of 2026-11-13 (scripts/conductor-reference/sidecar-diff), scenario plan-mode, Conductor's exitPlanMode and our requestInteraction carried the same plan and the approval reached the agent the same way.

sidecar_call:askUserQuestion.note: The sidecar asks the user the agent's question; ours sends requestInteraction with a question. Neither stage 2 nor the differential run sends it: no catalogue state runs a turn, so ours is shown by interactions.test.ts "SIDE-11 gives Codex permissions and MCP forms an expiry and questions none" and the question tool alias in constants.test.ts.

sidecar_call:codexMcpElicitation.note: The sidecar asks the app to answer a Codex MCP form; ours sends requestInteraction with an mcp_form. Neither stage 2 nor the differential run sends it: no catalogue state runs a turn, so ours is shown by approval-bridge.test.ts "an MCP form is shown as a card and accepted with its content".

sidecar_call:codexPermissionApproval.note: The sidecar asks the app to grant a Codex permission; ours sends requestInteraction with a permission_grant. Neither stage 2 nor the differential run sends it: no catalogue state runs a turn, so ours is shown by approval-bridge.test.ts "a permission request opens a permission grant with paths, reason and network".

sidecar_call:toolApproval.note: The sidecar asks the app to approve a tool call; ours sends requestInteraction with a tool_approval. In the sidecar differential run of 2026-11-13 (scripts/conductor-reference/sidecar-diff), scenarios approval and approval-denied, Conductor's toolApproval and our requestInteraction came at the same step and the answer reached the agent the same way.

sidecar_call:getDiff.note: The sidecar asks the app for the workspace diff for the GetWorkspaceDiff tool; ours is getWorkspaceDiff. Neither stage 2 nor the differential run sends it: no catalogue state runs a turn, so ours is shown by tools.test.ts "an empty diff is a plain no-changes answer, not an error".

sidecar_call:diffComment.note: The sidecar asks the app to add diff comments for the DiffComment tool; ours is addDiffComments. Neither stage 2 nor the differential run sends it: no catalogue state runs a turn, so ours is shown by tools.test.ts "two comments call addDiffComments once and answer Posted 2 comments".

sidecar_call:enterPlanModeNotification.note: The agent entered plan mode by itself; ours is agentConfigChanged with reason entered_plan_mode. Neither stage 2 nor the differential run sends it: no catalogue state runs a turn, so ours is shown by handlers.side-20.test.ts "stores the config the agent changed".

sidecar_call:checkpointCreated.note: A start or end checkpoint of a turn, with the changed files; ours stores it as a checkpoint event (events.ts type checkpoint) sent with sessionEvent. Neither stage 2 nor the differential run sends it: no catalogue state runs a turn, so ours is shown by checkpoint-service.test.ts "an end checkpoint uses the end phase in its id".

sidecar_call:frontendRelay.note: A request of the phone relay; remote control is D019's claude.ai route.

sidecar_call:keepAwake.note: Sent every few seconds while the phone relay waits on a relayed request, and Conductor's app does nothing with it (sidecar.js @1360353, main @3103285). Our keep-awake is PLAT-21's app-side rule.

sidecar_call:remoteControlPairedDevicesC.note: A backend name of the phone relay: pairing a device and the paired device list. Remote control is D019's claude.ai route.

sidecar_call:query.note: Starts a new turn with the message and the chat's settings; ours is sendMessage. In the sidecar differential run of 2026-11-13 (scripts/conductor-reference/sidecar-diff), every turn scenario sent Conductor's query and our sendMessage at the same step, and both agents got the same text.

sidecar_call:steer.note: Sends a message into a running turn; ours is sendMessage with delivery steer. Neither stage 2 nor the differential run sends it: no catalogue state runs a turn, so ours is shown by manager.test.ts "SIDE-03 a steer goes to the runner and stays pending until the agent reads it".

sidecar_call:updatePermissionMode.note: Switches a live Claude chat between plan and default mode; ours is updateConfig with planMode. Neither stage 2 nor the differential run sends it: no catalogue state runs a turn, so ours is shown by claude-session.test.ts "AGENT-04 plan mode, approvals and auto mode switch the live permission mode".

sidecar_call:setClaudeEditAutoAccept.note: Conductor's notice that lets a live Claude chat accept file edits for the rest of the session; ours is setAutoApproveEdits. Neither stage 2 nor the differential run sends it: no catalogue state runs a turn, so ours is shown by claude-session.test.ts "AGENT-04 setAutoApproveEdits lets the live chat accept an edit without asking".

sidecar_call:resetGenerator.note: Resets a chat's agent so the next message starts fresh; ours is resetAgent. Neither stage 2 nor the differential run sends it: no catalogue state runs a turn, so ours is shown by manager.test.ts "SIDE-03 resetAgent forgets the chat and stops its agent".

sidecar_call:setVerboseLogging.note: Turns the sidecar's verbose logging on or off; ours is setLogLevel. Stage 2 translates it to our setLogLevel, but no state of the run sent it; ours is shown by handlers.test.ts "SIDE-02 setLogLevel changes the root logger".

sidecar_call:setInternalUser.note: A backend name for Conductor's analytics, crash reporting, app logger or staff tools.

sidecar_call:setAppLoggerUrl.note: A backend name for Conductor's analytics, crash reporting, app logger or staff tools.

sidecar_call:setPostHogDistinctId.note: A backend name for Conductor's analytics, crash reporting, app logger or staff tools.

sidecar_call:setExternalLoggingDisabled.note: A backend name for Conductor's analytics, crash reporting, app logger or staff tools.

sidecar_call:setModelCatalog.note: Conductor's app pushes its hosted model catalog to the sidecar. D089: our sidecar reads each agent's list from the agent program, so nothing is pushed.

sidecar_call:claudeAuth.note: Starts the Claude sign-in through the sidecar; ours is startAgentLogin. Neither stage 2 nor the differential run sends it: no catalogue state runs a turn, so ours is shown by agent-catalog.test.ts "starts a sign-in for the agent and returns its instructions".

sidecar_call:codexAuth.note: Starts the Codex sign-in through the sidecar; ours is startAgentLogin. Neither stage 2 nor the differential run sends it: no catalogue state runs a turn, so ours is shown by agent-catalog.test.ts "starts a sign-in for the agent and returns its instructions".

sidecar_call:codexCloudAuthStart.note: A backend name of Conductor's hosted computers or its cloud sign-in. Our cloud is D018's.

sidecar_call:codexCloudAuthFinish.note: A backend name of Conductor's hosted computers or its cloud sign-in. Our cloud is D018's.

sidecar_call:cursorCloudAuthStart.note: A backend name of Conductor's hosted computers or its cloud sign-in. Our cloud is D018's.

sidecar_call:cursorCloudAuthFinish.note: A backend name of Conductor's hosted computers or its cloud sign-in. Our cloud is D018's.

sidecar_call:cursorCloudAuthCancel.note: A backend name of Conductor's hosted computers or its cloud sign-in. Our cloud is D018's.

sidecar_call:fetchAvailableMCP.note: Lists an agent's MCP servers in a workspace with their status; ours is listMcpServers. Neither stage 2 nor the differential run sends it: no catalogue state runs a turn, so ours is shown by s1-sidecar.join.test.ts "SIDE-21 model, slash command and MCP lists run the program and keys of the app's launch".

sidecar_call:fetchSlashCommands.note: Lists an agent's slash commands and skills; ours is listSlashCommands. In the sidecar differential run of 2026-11-13 (scripts/conductor-reference/sidecar-diff), scenario slash-commands, both lists matched by name.

sidecar_call:fetchPreWorkspaceCompletion.note: Slash commands and skills before a workspace exists, from a cached snapshot; ours is listSlashCommands without a workspace, answered from the cache (fromCache). Neither stage 2 nor the differential run sends it: no catalogue state runs a turn, so ours is shown by s1-sidecar.join.test.ts "SIDE-22 the slash command cache answers before a chat starts".

sidecar_call:listAcpModels.note: Lists an ACP agent's models; ours is listModels for every agent. Neither stage 2 nor the differential run sends it: no catalogue state runs a turn, so ours is shown by handlers.test.ts "SIDE-02 listModels is answered by the model catalog".

sidecar_call:fetchAcpSessionConfigOption.note: Lists an ACP chat's options beyond the model; ours is listAcpConfigOptions. Neither stage 2 nor the differential run sends it: no catalogue state runs a turn, so ours is shown by s1-sidecar.join.test.ts "AGENT-17 the ACP chat options are listed and set through the handlers".

sidecar_call:syncAcpSessionModel.note: Tells an ACP agent which model a reloaded chat uses. Ours does it in the same reconcile step that runs before listAcpConfigOptions answers and before the first prompt (runners/acp/acp-session.ts header). Neither stage 2 nor the differential run sends it: no catalogue state runs a turn, so ours is shown by s1-sidecar.join.test.ts "AGENT-17 the ACP chat options are listed and set through the handlers".

sidecar_call:setAcpSessionConfigOption.note: Sets one ACP chat option; ours is setAcpConfigOption. Neither stage 2 nor the differential run sends it: no catalogue state runs a turn, so ours is shown by s1-sidecar.join.test.ts "AGENT-17 the ACP chat options are listed and set through the handlers".

sidecar_call:listCodexModels.note: Lists the Codex models; ours is listModels with agent codex. In the sidecar differential run of 2026-11-13 (scripts/conductor-reference/sidecar-diff), scenario list-models-codex, both sidecars listed the same models by name. In stage 2 it fails with "Codex is not installed": the run's world has no Codex, and Conductor's sidecar lists through codex app-server too (sidecar.js @12374406).

sidecar_call:warmShellEnv.note: Warms the login-shell environment for a folder; ours captures it with getShellEnv (and on warmAgent). Stage 2 translates it to our getShellEnv, but no state of the run sent it; ours is shown by shell-env-handlers.test.ts "asks the provider for the workspace path it was given".

sidecar_call:persistedSessionEvent.note: The app confirms an event is stored; ours is eventPersisted. In the sidecar differential run of 2026-11-13 (scripts/conductor-reference/sidecar-diff) the app acknowledged every stored event this way on both sidecars.

sidecar_call:remoteControlChanges.note: Sends the phone relay host the workspace changes it mirrors to a paired phone (sidecar.js @1352532: workspace, repository and revision rows). Our Remote Control is D019's claude.ai route.

sidecar_call:remoteControlStart.note: Starts Conductor's phone relay host: its parameters are the Conductor user id, host name and Roundhouse URL (sidecar.js @1354202). Our Remote Control is D019's claude.ai route, started with a chat's config.

sidecar_call:remoteControlStop.note: Stops Conductor's phone relay host (sidecar.js @12418115, beside the pairing offers and paired devices). Our Remote Control is D019's claude.ai route.

sidecar_call:remoteControlStatus.note: Reads the state of Conductor's phone relay host (sidecar.js @12418115). Our Remote Control is D019's claude.ai route.

sidecar_call:remoteControlCreatePairingO.note: A backend name of the phone relay: pairing a device and the paired device list. Remote control is D019's claude.ai route.

sidecar_call:remoteControlClearPairingOf.note: A backend name of the phone relay: pairing a device and the paired device list. Remote control is D019's claude.ai route.

sidecar_call:remoteControlListPairedDevi.note: A backend name of the phone relay: pairing a device and the paired device list. Remote control is D019's claude.ai route.

sidecar_call:remoteControlRemovePairedDe.note: A backend name of the phone relay: pairing a device and the paired device list. Remote control is D019's claude.ai route.

sidecar_call:codexRollback.item: Codex rollback: resume a Codex thread only up to a chosen message (ours is resume.atNativeMessageId).

sidecar_call:codexCompact.note: Shrinks a Codex thread's history through thread/compact/start; ours is compact. Neither stage 2 nor the differential run sends it: no catalogue state runs a turn, so ours is shown by s1-sidecar.join.test.ts "AGENT-14 a Codex chat compacts its history through the compact handler".

sidecar_call:contextUsage.note: Asks for a chat's context and plan usage; ours is getContextUsage. Neither stage 2 nor the differential run sends it: no catalogue state runs a turn, so ours is shown by usage-wiring.test.ts "SIDE-17 the handler reads context usage and plan limits from the live agent".

sidecar_call:acpOneShotPrompt.note: One short prompt through an ACP agent for a title or branch name; D030 makes runUtilityPrompt cover it for every agent. Neither stage 2 nor the differential run sends it: no catalogue state runs a turn, so ours is shown by handlers.test.ts "SIDE-24 runUtilityPrompt is answered by the utility runner".

sidecar_call:cursorOneShotPrompt.note: One short prompt through the Cursor agent for a title or branch name; D030 makes runUtilityPrompt cover it for every agent. Neither stage 2 nor the differential run sends it: no catalogue state runs a turn, so ours is shown by handlers.test.ts "SIDE-24 runUtilityPrompt is answered by the utility runner".

sidecar_call:answerUserQuestion.note: The app answers a question card; ours is answerInteraction. Neither stage 2 nor the differential run sends it: no catalogue state runs a turn, so ours is shown by interactions.test.ts "SIDE-11 an answer must have the kind of its interaction, and withdrawn fits all".

sidecar_call:startAgentationProxy.note: Starts a proxy that puts the page-annotation toolbar into the in-app preview. Ours attaches the picker to the preview frame from the app (RUN-05, AnnotationOverlay.tsx), so the sidecar has no proxy.

sidecar_call:listLocalhostPorts.note: Asks Conductor's sidecar for the ports listening on localhost. D032 reads listening ports with lsof in the app's own shell call, so the sidecar has no such method.

sidecar_call:getHarnessVersions.note: Asks for the installed agent program versions; ours is getAgentInstalls. In stage 2's run of 2026-11-13 on this branch, our getAgentInstalls answered all 120 of its calls in the first 200 states.

sidecar_call:harnessVersionsNotification.note: The installed agent program versions; ours is agentInstallsChanged. In the sidecar differential run of 2026-11-13 (scripts/conductor-reference/sidecar-diff) each sidecar sent its notice as the app connected, in every scenario.

sidecar_call:crashTest.note: A backend name for Conductor's analytics, crash reporting, app logger or staff tools.
